label: Copy-phase update gate, strongest on final output of length-3 sequences
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (t > L), never on original tokens or the <DEL> step, and only on copy inputs that repeat an earlier token. Its strongest and most reliable firing is the last copy step of 3-token sequences (t=5, outputting orig(2)): 81% precision there, and it accounts for most of the top activation quartile. Elsewhere it fires sparsely (about 1-6% of steps) late in longer sequences, peaking at recall_idx 2, 5 and 8 and on the last two outputs (to_go <= 1), with mild preferences for inputs l/o/2 and output c. No positional or token predicate captured these with useful precision. The predicate covers about 31% of activation mass. Absolute magnitudes are tiny (max about 0.001 above threshold).
